scope: Thirty curated extensions with exact accepted targets and computed prerequisite paths. Method-focused links for underrepresented fields are explicitly bounded; no complete field syllabus is claimed.

routes.title: Sets, choices and coordinates — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Test a set identity with overlapping finite sets, then contrast that discrete representation with barycentric coordinates.
routes.limits: Elementary arithmetic, proof writing, mathematical history and non-European traditions need further routes.

routes.title: Samples, counterfactuals and measurements — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Separate a sampling-distribution calculation from the exchangeability assumption needed for a causal comparison.
routes.limits: Qualitative inquiry, research ethics, sampling design and Indigenous research methods remain to broaden.

targets.title: Moments of the sample mean; unbiasedness of S²

routes.title: Inputs, strings and syntax trees — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Write an invariant and an induction argument. Identify the base case and the step where each claim is preserved.
routes.limits: Networking practice, databases, security, accessibility and programming projects are further curriculum work.

routes.title: Motion, energy and periodic waves — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Draw an energy-flow account and an interference example. Explain why a diagram of wave amplitudes is not an energy-flow ledger.
routes.limits: Astronomy, experimental uncertainty, quantum theory and regional histories of physical inquiry remain broader topics.

targets.title: Primary, final and useful energy: the Sankey diagram

routes.title: Gas, reaction and bonding models — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare a reaction-rate law with structural forms of iron. Separate a kinetic relation from a description of material structure.
routes.limits: Laboratory practice, organic chemistry, analytical methods and material histories need distinct safe routes.

targets.title: Rate law, rate constant and reaction order

routes.title: Location, rock transformations and spectral scales — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare an ellipsoid model with the historical longitude problem. Distinguish coordinate assumptions from evidence about time measurement.
routes.limits: Oceans, weather observation, human geography, mapping ethics and situated place knowledge remain underrepresented.

targets.title: The Earth as an oblate ellipsoid
The marine chronometer and the longitude problem

routes.title: Gene copies, regulation and populations — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Contrast random allele sampling with deterministic local stability. Show why stable expectations do not remove random variation.
routes.limits: Organismal diversity, anatomy, evolution beyond the model, field observation and laboratory methods need expansion.

targets.title: Linear stability of equilibria in one dimension

routes.title: Niches, population balances and situated outcomes — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Distinguish a modeled growth law from evidence about a realized niche. State one observation needed before applying either.
routes.limits: Conservation decisions, ecological field data, marine systems and local stewardship are future routes.

routes.title: Observation, measurement and communication — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Audit a claimed improvement and a confidence-set statement. This is research literacy, not a diagnosis or a clinical recommendation.
routes.limits: Public health, social determinants, disability, mental health and care practice need separate evidence and sources.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: A sample, a water ledger and a farming system — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare a population-growth projection with an observed farming outcome. List environmental and assignment assumptions before making a causal claim.
routes.limits: Food preparation, forestry, fisheries, veterinary knowledge and locally situated agricultural practice remain broader work.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: Feedback, energy and stress — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Explain feedback in a governor, then identify loads and stress modes in a schematic. These models are not construction instructions.
routes.limits: These are models, not building, electrical or machine safety instructions; manufacturing practice needs additional curricula.

routes.title: Equilibrium, supports and geometric representation — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Follow a load path and an anamorphic viewing construction. Separate structural claims from projection effects.
routes.limits: Urban planning, dwelling histories, landscape, access and current building codes are not covered by these three models.

routes.title: Choice, output and accumulation — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Explain one omission from GDP and why arithmetic and geometric returns answer different questions. Do not treat either as a welfare measure.
routes.limits: Economic institutions, inequality, labour, political economy and regional histories need additional readings.

routes.title: Resources, finance and consumer obligations — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Reconcile a fictional ledger, then distinguish a recorded cash cost from an opportunity cost.
routes.limits: Accounting, governance, cooperative organizations, management and local business institutions remain missing subjects.

targets.title: A balanced ledger can still be wrong

routes.title: Votes and diplomatic claims — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Apply alternative voting rules to a fixed preference profile. Explain which change comes from the rule rather than changed voters.
routes.limits: Public administration, lawmaking, comparative institutions, political traditions and participation need more situated accounts.

routes.title: Facts, remedies and jurisdiction — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Keep authority identity separate from empirical causal assumptions. Neither a catalog field nor a statistical assumption establishes a legal holding.
routes.limits: Criminal, constitutional, family, international and customary law need their own jurisdictions and dated sources.

routes.title: Aggregate patterns, population accounting and situated accounts — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Contrast a segregation mechanism with cohort-component accounting. Explain why a plausible simulation is not an observed community history.
routes.limits: Ethnography, kinship, institutions, social theory and participant perspectives remain broader needs.

routes.title: Detection, comparison and interpretation — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Read a psychometric curve and design a comparison with a defined outcome. Separate task performance from broad mental capacity.
routes.limits: Development, memory, social psychology, emotion and cross-cultural methods need distinct source-backed routes.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: Explanation, teaching offers and checking learning — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Draft a delayed explanation task and interpret uncertainty for a defined comparison. No observed learning gain is supplied.
routes.limits: Curriculum design, educational history, disability access and formal/informal learning institutions need expansion.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: Documents, diplomatic voices and material evidence — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare an attributed museum interpretation with work/edition metadata. Name the source type needed to strengthen each historical claim.
routes.limits: Periods, regions, oral histories and archaeological methods remain far broader than these selected cases.

targets.title: A dated object, a visual effect, an interpretation

routes.title: Reconstruction, disclosure and institutional claims — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Make consistency, interference and comparison assumptions explicit. Discuss which are empirical premises and which define the question.
routes.limits: Metaphysics, epistemology, aesthetics and wider intellectual traditions require additional original-language and contextual sources.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: Texts, service accounts and situated performance listings — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Separate religious interpretation in one historical object from catalog classification. Neither stands in for lived practice or community authority.
routes.limits: This is not a survey of religions; lived practice, nonreligious worldviews, regions and original-language traditions remain underrepresented.

targets.title: A dated object, a visual effect, an interpretation

routes.title: Contrast, translation and communication — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Explain how complementary distribution differs from a distinctive feature. Preserve the language-specific evidence behind each analysis.
routes.limits: Signed languages, writing systems, multilingual contexts and community language knowledge need further sources.

routes.title: Translations, editions and narrative access — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Separate edition identity, witness evidence and interpretation. Record what a catalog can establish without having read a work.
routes.limits: Genres, periods, regions, oral literatures and additional source languages remain extensive future work.

targets.title: A dated object, a visual effect, an interpretation

routes.title: Projection and situated textile accounts — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Connect a geometric viewing effect with an attributed historical interpretation while keeping the two evidence claims distinct.
routes.limits: Art histories, material processes, criticism, conservation and diverse visual traditions need additional sources.

targets.title: A dated object, a visual effect, an interpretation

routes.title: Sound quantities and an authored phrase — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare pitch relations and spectral timbre. Explain why an acoustic representation does not exhaust musical meaning.
routes.limits: Music histories, composition, traditions, improvisation and situated listening are not exhausted by acoustics.

targets.title: Timbre and the spectra of instruments

routes.title: A phrase, a staging plan and a repertoire listing — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Compare a reported viewing effect with a modeled response curve. Plan an original observation without claiming that an audience study occurred.
routes.limits: Dance, film, embodied training, audience studies and additional performance traditions need separate artifacts.

targets.title: A dated object, a visual effect, an interpretation

routes.title: Sources, mediation and versions — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Trace record identity and timestamps before using a source in a learning claim. Metadata does not substitute for reading the underlying work.
routes.limits: Newsroom practice, libraries, records management, media production and platform studies remain wider subjects.

targets.title: A learning recommendation is not your result

routes.title: Interlacing, patch plans and situated teaching — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Account for fictional material purchases and inspect schematic stress modes. Neither proves a made object is safe or fit for use.
routes.limits: Tools, materials, trades, domestic skills and actual situated making require additional evidence and lessons.

targets.title: A balanced ledger can still be wrong

routes.title: Trajectory models and strategic play — extend the inquiry
routes.task: Solve a small strategic game and compare equilibrium with iterated elimination of dominated strategies. The model does not establish coaching advice or athletic skill.
routes.limits: Sport history, coaching, movement access, recreation, rules and embodied skills remain major gaps; these models do not establish athletic competence.
